:::{#def-union}
#### Union

The **union** of sets $A$ and $B$,
written $A \cup B$,
is the set of elements that are in $A$, in $B$, or in both:

$$A \cup B \eqdef \set{x : x \in A \text{ or } x \in B}$$

More generally, let $I$ be a set of indices,
such as $\cb{1, \ldots, n}$ or $\cb{1, 2, 3, \ldots}$,
and let $A_i$ be a set for each $i \in I$.
The union of the sets $A_i$,
written $\bigcup_{i \in I} A_i$,
is the set of elements that are in at least one $A_i$.

:::
